## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds or changes only `apps/<name>.<prefix>/` (no change to `ghostly-store.json`,
      `ghostly-store.sig`, `STORE_KEY`, `scripts/` or `.github/`).
- [ ] `ref`, `sequence` and `digest` in `listing.json` are what `ghostly app verify` prints for the bundle.
- [ ] Every URL is `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/...`, or `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/<owner>/<repo>@<full commit>/...`,
      and at least one is the jsDelivr one, pinned to a full commit.
- [ ] The source is public, and its license allows the app to be listed.
- [ ] The app follows the [review rules](../README.md#review-rules): it does what it says, sends nothing about the
      person without saying so, and has no ads, tracking or mining.
- [ ] My publisher key is backed up, and it is not in any repository.
